title: Keep the retained registration-pending recovery guidance visible in the launcher failure text
outcome: An unconfirmed recovery that retains a validated pending registration also tells the operator to retry the unchanged original request, while preserving the latest recovery diagnostic.
acceptance: When an earlier validated pending registration is retained after an unconfirmed recovery, the launcher failure text explicitly says durability remains pending and directs the operator to the unchanged original request; keep the latest error diagnostic first and retain bounded output.

A behavioral HTTP-fixture case observes that guidance for an unconfirmed recovery while preserving the typed pending identity/stateLock, exactly two identical POSTs, no receipt and no stage execution.
